messages:
Sarah: Quick heads-up — kb-scan picked up ~12 orphan anchors under /guides/, plus one embedded gist that's returning a 404 in the runbook. Anyone own guides/runbooks to claim?
CJ: I'll take anchors in /guides/section-2, pushing small PRs for each anchor.
Maria: I can rehost the gist and update the embed. Which gist id is throwing 404?
Sarah: gist id 3f2a7c — embedded here: https://gist.github.com/3f2a7c. Staging shows 404/403 depending on org access.
Timothy: FYI that one looks like a private fork. Rehost to an internal gist or replace with a fenced code block. Internal hosting preferred for onboarding guides.
CJ: pinging @Maria for rehost. I'll open a PR for the anchor fixes: title "fix: guides anchors + redirects" and will break into tiny commits.
Maria: Rehosted to https://gist.redwood/internal/3f2a7c and swapped the embed to point there. Opened PR #4387 — could someone review the embed change?
devex-bot: New PR opened by Maria: #4387 — checks: ci/docs-lint passed.
Timothy: Quick grep to find other embeds: `rg -n "gist.github.com/.+3f2a7c" content/ | wc -l` — run that before merging to catch leftovers.
CJ: Running that locally now, will include results in the PR description.
Sarah: Thanks — can we try to merge by EOD? It's affecting new-hire onboarding preview.
Maria: Will request review from @Timothy and @CJ and add a short release-note entry.
CJ: Reviewed, added a tiny docslint tweak and one redirect rule. :thumbsup:
Sarah: Merged and deployed — onboarding preview fixed. :tada:
Maria: Closing thread, leaving a TODO in the runbook to avoid external gist embeds in onboarding content.
__notes: This thread contains an asynchronous coordination exchange about orphan anchors and a broken gist embed in internal docs; short informal slack-style messages with @mentions, a small code snippet, and a bot PR notification.
